project.name: Verdant Greenhouse Monitor
project.description: Monitoring app for a commercial greenhouse: sensor telemetry, pest detections, alerts, and remote device management.

direction.palette: Atmospheric gradients (sky blue → sunset → storm grey) + temp scale

app.name: Verdant Greenhouse Monitor
app.tagline: Real-time environmental telemetry, pest vision alerts, and device health for commercial greenhouses

looks.reason: Structured grid and clear technical presentation suitable for dense environmental metrics and alerts.
Clean high-contrast data display maximizing scanning speed for greenhouse operators.
Translucent panels and modern aesthetic fitting tech-forward environmental monitoring hardware.

requested.words: clean and technical, light background, a leaf green accent

design.reason: Operators and admins monitor live sensor streams, acknowledge alerts, inspect pest imagery, and manage device lifecycles.
replaced: Reading: title 'value' left out (a float field is not a name)
look 'neon' left out: a neon look does not suit this product

tours.name: Monitor conditions and acknowledge alerts
tours.outcome: Environmental anomaly is acknowledged and tracked for resolution

steps.title: Review sensor readings, charts, and active alerts on the dashboard (the alert becomes active). Rule: Readings must display latest values and 24-hour historical trends
Acknowledge the alert (the alert becomes acknowledged). Rule: Only active alerts can be acknowledged

tours.name: Review pest detections
tours.outcome: Pest detection is confirmed for greenhouse treatment or dismissed as a false alarm

steps.title: Review pest snapshot, classification, and confidence score (the detection becomes pending). Rule: Detections must include snapshot, identified pest, and confidence score
Confirm the pest detection (the detection becomes confirmed). Rule: Only pending detections can be confirmed

tours.name: Manage device health
tours.outcome: Unhealthy device is rebooted to restore normal monitoring

steps.title: Identify offline or low battery devices on the dashboard (the device becomes unhealthy). Rule: Offline or low-battery devices must be highlighted
Send reboot command to the device (the device becomes rebooting). Rule: Only admins can issue reboot commands to devices
